caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #60: ARROGATE

arrogate (verb): to claim or seize something without the right to it.

✅ In a sentence: The chair arrogated the power to approve budgets, which belonged to the full board.
✅ Similar: seize, usurp, appropriate
✅ Remember it: Same root as "arrogant": taking what isn't yours.
